WardensGranddaughterText1:
My grandpa is the
SAFARI ZONE WAR- DEN.

At least he was…

He decided to go
on a vacation and

took off overseas
all by himself.

He quit running
SAFARI ZONE just like that.
WardensGranddaughterText2:
Many people were
disappointed that

SAFARI ZONE closed
down, but Grandpa is so stubborn…
